_readme: Translations of in-game names contributed by people who speak the language.
tools/fetch_names.py collects the official ones from Blizzard, who publish the game in
ten of the fifteen languages this app speaks. The other five - Chinese (Simplified),
Ukrainian, Swedish, Arabic and Turkish - have no official source, so the app shows the
English name inside an otherwise translated screen. This file is where that gets fixed.
The shape is { "<language>": { "<English>": "<your translation>" } }, where the
English side must match the dataset exactly, including capitals. Language tags are the
ones below: zhCN, uk, sv, ar, tr - and any of the ten official ones too, if the official
wording is wrong. Anything here wins over what Blizzard published.
Partial is fine and expected. A name with no entry falls back to English, so ten good
translations help ten screens; nobody has to finish a language to contribute to it.
Names only, please. Ability descriptions are a paragraph each and there are thousands;
if you want to take those on as well, open an issue first so two people do not translate
